proof:
classical
  intro hJ
  obtain ⟨s, hs⟩ := h_T010
  have hc (c : J p M (ev y v 0)) : (c : ℂ) = 0 := by
    have hc' := c.property
    rw [hJ] at hc'
    exact Submodule.mem_bot.mp hc'
  have hLzero (u : L p M) : (u : V) = 0 := by
    rw [← s.apply_symm_apply u, hs]
    apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
    intro i hi
    rw [hc]
    exact zero_smul ℂ _
  have hspan : Submodule.span ℂ (M : Set V) = ⊤ := h_T008.2.1.2.2.1
  have htop : (⊤ : Submodule ℂ V) ≤ ⊥ := by
    rw [← hspan]
    apply Submodule.span_le.mpr
    intro m hm
    apply Submodule.mem_bot.mpr
    exact hLzero ⟨m, Submodule.subset_span hm⟩
  let i : Ix l := ⟨0, Nat.zero_lt_succ _⟩
  have hz : ev y v i.val = 0 :=
    Submodule.mem_bot.mp (htop (Submodule.mem_top))
  exact (h_T005.2.1 i).1 hz
